capability_owner: Logion CS Evidence / Verification and Evaluation Sources

source.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology

formula_model.model_rule: predict heldout CVSS v3.x base score from training-only medians over CWE, CPE-count bin, reference-count bin, and visible description/reference/source tokens; baseScore, severity, CVSS vector metrics, exploitabilityScore, and impactScore remain hidden until scoring

comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: predict heldout CVSS score from the training-only median score for the same CWE, otherwise the global training median

aggregate.material_margin_rule: model mean absolute CVSS residual must be strictly below the preregistered prior-CWE median comparator and the shuffled-target control must be rejected

negative_control.description: rotate heldout CVSS scores by one row after visible predictions are materialized
negative_control.rejection_predicate: control target map hash differs from locked target map and control model MAE exceeds locked-target model MAE
